summary: Filled the blank Homebrew tap repository.owner with the printer handle (chiotas) and replaced the malformed homepage URL with the library repo, matching library convention.
reason: The 4.22.1 generator emitted goreleaser.yaml with an empty owner and a homepage of https://github.com//nisifilters-pp-cli, which GoReleaser cannot publish to; flagged P1 by Greptile on the publish PR.
validated_outcome: yaml parses; owner/homepage now match the pattern used by every other published commerce CLI.
